statements.venue: Press release introducing the Data Center Community Impact Act
statements.quote: Infrastructure projects, like the AI data centers being built, are important to the success of industry and economic growth in this country, but we must first protect the health of people and the planet
statements.context: Introducing a bill for a federal study of the environmental, economic and public health effects of data centers, especially on communities of color and low-income communities.
statements.reason: The statement is about local health and environmental effects of AI data centers, which is outside catastrophic AI risk.

record: Introduced the Data Center Community Impact Act, calling for a federal study of data centers' environmental, economic and public health effects.
Original cosponsor of the House AI Data Center Moratorium Act (H.R. 9442), pausing new AI data center construction until national safeguards are in place.
Cosponsored H.R. 9939, to prohibit AI data centers on federal land.
Cosponsored H.R. 10841, the Securing Elections From AI Deception Act.

With State Senator Zwicker, wrote to the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection asking it to pause permitting of the Sentinel Data Center in South Brunswick over gaps in its environmental review.
Co-introduced with Rep. Landsman the Ban AI Denials in Medicare Act, to bar the Department of Health and Human Services from testing an AI prior-authorization model in traditional Medicare.
Search result summary of watsoncoleman.house.gov material; release page returned HTTP 410 when opened 2026-11-14
